themes.name: Light
themes.note: Used when the person picks Light (or System with a light OS setting). The depth ladder is inverted: the page is the lightest neutral and each rung up is a step darker. bg-000, fg-media and the live viewfinder keep their dark values because they sit on camera and video.

tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Camera viewfinder while the camera is live. Nothing else sits this dark.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: The app shell and page background, under the dot grid. Also the ground inside an idle viewfinder.

tokens.name: bg-150
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a document preview (the schedule PDF) inside an open tile.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom bar fill (the solid bar; the floating dock uses `glass`).

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Inset fields: search and date inputs, textarea, the segmented-control track, the audit diff box, a disabled tile.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and dashboard tiles, the right rail, sticky panel heads. The main working surface.

tokens.name: surface-head
tokens.usage: Table header rows, the totals row, sub-section heads inside a tile, and the dialog body.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on table rows, nav items, tile heads and accordion questions; an expanded audit or note row.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Default buttons, selects, menus, popovers and the date/time pickers.

tokens.name: surface-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, video thumbnails and a selected table row.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: The current nav item and ghost-button hover.

tokens.name: surface-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a default button.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed segment, menu-item hover, split-button hover, an active filter chip.

tokens.name: range-band
tokens.usage: The band between the start and end days of a date range in the calendar. The start and end days are fg squares.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables and lists; also the fill of the current item in the mobile dock.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel and tile borders, panel-head dividers, the sidebar section rule.

tokens.name: line-chip
tokens.usage: Border of a date or time chip in a range field (date and time range pickers).

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, inputs, menus, status tags and the vertical separator. As in the mockup these borders are quiet (1.5:1 on `surface`), so a control is always also told apart by its `surface-raised` fill or its label.

tokens.name: line-dashed
tokens.usage: The dashed border of an upload drop zone.

tokens.name: line-hover
tokens.usage: Chip, select and peek-tile border on hover; the underline under a linked number.

tokens.name: line-check
tokens.usage: Border of an unchecked menu checkbox.

tokens.name: line-focus
tokens.usage: Focused input border, the idle viewfinder corners, the breadcrumb slash. 2.4:1 on `bg-300`, below the 3:1 a focus mark needs, so keyboard focus also gets the solid 2px `fg` outline (see the brand book).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty track of a progress bar.

tokens.name: track-upcoming
tokens.usage: Day segments still to come in the event progress strip.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every ground from `bg-000` to `surface-pressed`. Also the fill of a primary button, a pressed pill and the live viewfinder corners.

tokens.name: fg-strong
tokens.usage: Hover text on buttons and links, and the primary button's hover fill. Never resting text.

tokens.name: fg-media
tokens.usage: A tile label over the blurred document thumbnail, where `fg-3` would sink.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: nav items at rest, emails, schools, summaries, ghost-button labels. Legible on every ground up to `surface-pressed`.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, timestamps, placeholders and resting icons, on every ground from `bg-000` to `surface-pressed` (4.6:1 at worst, on `surface-pressed`; 4.9:1 on `surface-active`). Lightened from the mockup's #8a8a8a so it clears 4.5:1 on the hover and pressed grounds.

tokens.name: fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, an empty value (a dash) and resting heart or note icons. 3.3:1 on `surface`: fine for inactive controls and 16px icons, never for live text.

tokens.name: fill-done
tokens.usage: Event days already past in the day progress strip.

tokens.name: fill-bar
tokens.usage: Progress-bar fill and the paper of a document preview.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Live state: the LIVE word, a connected status icon, today's share of the day strip. The default `accent`.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Alternative event accent, chosen per event.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Alternative event accent, chosen per event.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The event's accent, set per event (`live` by default; `amber`, `sky` or `fg` are the other choices). Only for the LIVE word, live status and today's progress; never for buttons or large fills.

tokens.name: count
tokens.usage: Counts beside a nav item (the roster sizes in the sidebar).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete event, Remove) and an offline status icon. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `fg` fill: the primary button, a pressed pill, the dock's current item, the QR modules.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a modal dialog; also the duration badge on a video thumbnail.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating mobile dock, with a 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Scan result laid over the live camera, with an 8px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: dot-grid
tokens.usage: The 1px dot grid on the app shell, at a 14px pitch.

styles.name: display-day
styles.usage: The event day in the right rail, followed by `title-sm` "of 3" in `fg-3`.

styles.name: display-stat
styles.usage: The one number on a peek tile (requests, checked in, callbacks). Follow it with a `control` caption in `fg-3`.

styles.name: bib-hero
styles.usage: A dancer's bib on their own check-in pass.

styles.name: bib-lg
styles.usage: A bib on a scan result or a dancer's peek tile.

styles.name: rank
styles.usage: Rank numbers in a top-choices list.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title in the header, dialog titles, the name on a pass.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: The workspace name in the sidebar switcher and a scan result's dancer name.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Sidebar nav items and accordion questions.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, menu items, detail values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in rows, roster links, the user's name. Use 600 only for a panel title.

styles.name: body-long
styles.sample: Check in at the front desk with your pass.
styles.usage: Running prose: FAQ answers and note text, in `fg-2`.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Labels on buttons, chips, segments, selects and search inputs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small buttons (24px), audit filters, secondary notes.

styles.name: caption-sm
styles.usage: Detail-list terms and the user's email under their name, in `fg-3`.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Bibs and right-aligned numbers in tables, with tabular figures.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: File names, timestamps in the audit log, the header dates, counts in a panel head.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata lines under a title, relative times, the LIVE badge and percentages.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE section and column labels (`lbl`) in `fg-3`; status words in a table.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: UPPERCASE text inside a bordered status tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between nav items and between segments.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, day segments and stacked lines in a peek tile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside buttons and chips; menu padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: THE gutter: between panels, tiles and the sidebar edge; sidebar padding; header-to-actions gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Button side padding; icon-to-label gap in nav items and menu items.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Header gap and table column gap; dialog footer padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Inner padding of panels and tiles (left edge of every head and row).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Padding around the scanner.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Padding inside the viewfinder and a check-in pass.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Document paper, rating segments, skeleton lines.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Progress bars and day segments.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Status tags, video thumbnails in a peek grid, menu checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-5
tokens.usage: Chips, the header LIVE badge, segment buttons, calendar cells, 24px buttons.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, menu items, the org mark.

tokens.name: radius-7
tokens.usage: The segmented-control track (radius-5 inside + 2px padding).

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Workspace switcher, inset boxes (diff, drop zone), video cards.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-11
tokens.usage: Items inside the floating mobile dock.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the viewfinder.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: 26px-tall pill toggles (Call back, top-choice picks): half their height.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: The floating mobile dock.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Every panel and tile. Disabled tiles drop it.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, date and time pickers.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-dock
tokens.usage: The floating mobile dock.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: A document page inside a preview.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in tile heads, chips, segment buttons, status tags.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects, split buttons and icon buttons (28 square).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog buttons, the scanner's Open camera, nav items, inputs inside a dialog.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Table rows, tile heads and collapsed tile strips.

tokens.name: row-head
tokens.usage: Table header rows.

tokens.name: panel-head
tokens.usage: Panel header height.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: The page header bar.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed (icon-only) sidebar width.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Right event rail width: beside the widgets above 1000px, wrapped below them from 1000px down.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Nav and strip icons.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, chips, menus and table cells.

tokens.name: tile-open
tokens.usage: Height of an open dashboard widget; shorter screens use the window height under the header minus 72px (at least 400px).

tokens.name: tile-peek-m
tokens.usage: Height of a stacked widget peek on phones (800px and below).

tokens.name: bp-sidebar
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: at and below this width the sidebar collapses on its own.

tokens.name: bp-board
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: at and below this width boards with a second row go to 3 widgets per row.

tokens.name: bp-rail
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: at and below this width the rail wraps below the widgets and the header shows the LIVE badge and dates.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: at and below this width the phone layout applies (dock, stacked widgets, fewer table columns).

tokens.name: bp-small
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: at and below this width header dates hide, tables drop another column and buttons go icon-only.
